conditioning: fixed adopted B/F trajectories; not end-to-end stochastic stability
membership: all selected inputs, including untriggered, invalid and ordinary failed results
seed_summary: all preregistered seeds reported; equal seed and backbone weights, never best seed

uncertainty.target: paired correctness-difference on same inputs, failures retained; average across fixed seeds
uncertainty.limitation: small families/wide intervals mean weak evidence, not proof of population zero

cost: new physical calls/tokens/model seconds, frozen B/F inherited cost separately, no duplicated physical sum
adoption: Review net benefit across both fixed panels and all seeds, native metrics and family/format regressions against extra cost. No zero-harm rule or online gold gate. If signal inconsistent/insufficient, equivalent_B remains default and ordinary reanswer remains optional experimental control; no further prompt search.
